title: Presheaf scalar restriction has a left adjoint in larger universes
statement: Let k be a ring, X a topological space and R a sheaf of rings on X, all in universe u, with alpha:k -> R(X). For every universe v, the presheaf pushforward along the identity site and the structural map [def-sc-field-scalar-presheaf-ring-map], from R-module presheaves with carriers in Type(max u v) to modules over the constant k-presheaf, is a right adjoint. No commutativity or field hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Sheaves on Spaces, Tags 0095 and 0096; Modules, Tag 02N4. Canonical online tag pages consulted; noncommutative presheaf construction and universe bookkeeping made explicit by M2.

proof.text: At each open U construct the free left R(U)-module on the underlying set of V(U), as finitely supported functions V(U) -> R(U). Quotient by the R(U)-submodule spanned by [m+n]-[m]-[n] and [c m]-alpha_U(c)[m]. The quotient is in Type(max u v). Its generators are additive and k-linear, and every additive k-linear map into a restricted R(U)-module extends uniquely to an R(U)-linear map. Lean helpers relations, generator_add, generator_smul, extensionLift and extension_hom_ext prove these claims directly from the Finsupp and submodule quotient APIs.

Define restriction along U -> W by extending the map m -> [res(m)] into the quotient at W, regarded as an R(U)-module via the ring restriction. The naturality of alpha from the structural map gives the required balancing identity. Identity and composition hold on generators, hence everywhere by the quotient free-module extensionality lemma. This defines extensionObj with carriers in Type(max u v).

The generators give extensionUnit from V to scalar restriction of extensionObj V. A natural map from V to scalar restriction of N gives extensionDesc by the sectionwise universal property. Its naturality is checked on generators. These operations are inverse: extension followed by restriction agrees on generators, and restriction followed by extension agrees on every section of V. Thus extensionHomEquiv is the hom bijection, natural in N.
Apply CategoryTheory.Adjunction.adjunctionOfEquivLeft to extensionHomEquiv. Naturality in N follows componentwise by function composition. Its isRightAdjoint property is the required conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem fieldScalarPresheafPullback_isRightAdjoint
    {k : Type u} [Ring k] (X : TopCat.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    (α : k →+* R.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :
    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward.{max u v}
      (fieldScalarPresheafRingMap X R α)).IsRightAdjoint
